The text describes a setting with horse-drawn carriages, gas lighting, and cobblestone streets, which are characteristic of the 19th century. The mention of Georgian and Victorian architecture further narrows the time period to the 18th and 19th centuries, specifically the Victorian era (1837–1901). The reference to Charles Dickens, who was a prominent author during the Victorian era, reinforces this dating. Therefore, the text likely originates from or describes the mid-to-late 19th century.

The part of a tree that grows underground is the root.
